title: Managing Jimmy Clanton and sending him to a choreographer
summary: Matassa managed Clanton for three years; he found him hard to manage and could not get him to learn a nightclub act or stage presence.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work
